column_source_invalid: Cannot recognize the keyword or formula. Restored the previous source.
column_source_unverified: Syntax recognized. Using {{source}}; {{keys}} are not listed in the schema, so values depend on the image TOML.
column_source_unchanged: Column title saved; the keyword or formula is unchanged.
column_source_help_syntax: Use a TOML field as a keyword, for example AE_TAG_REALBVX1000. Formulas start with =; if omitted, it is added on save. Supported: numbers, parentheses, +, -, *, /, abs, log2, min, max.
column_source_help_validation: Saving checks syntax. Unknown but valid fields may be saved; the image TOML must contain them. Missing values or division by zero display -.
column_source_help_aliases: AE Basic also supports Normal_old, Normal_new, BackTar_old, BackTar_new, FLinkTar_old, FLinkTar_new, CWR_old, and CWR_new. Field names are case-sensitive; old values are outside parentheses and new values are inside.
column_source_help_delta: =CWR_new - CWR_old calculates ∆CWR for each available scene target.
column_source_help_ev: =log2(CWR_new / CWR_old) displays Normal|BackTar|FLinkTar EV, each to three decimal places.
column_source_help_ae_gain: AEGain(new) uses =FLinkTar_old / BackTar_old(FLinkTar_new / BackTar_new) and displays old(new); only the new value inside parentheses changes color.
column_source_help_colors: Values above the positive threshold are red; values below the negative threshold are blue. Values within the threshold keep the default text color.
column_source_help_save: The row Save button validates the source and restores the previous one if invalid. Complete writes the column settings.
